changelog:
radio-drama-ad-break 0.1.1

- Initial release: create labeled bumper audio clips from written radio-drama ad-break lines.
- Accepts pre-roll, post-roll, and other bumper copy, returning 8–20 individual spoken clips.
- Ensures correct pronunciation for any names or brands by requiring a pronunciation table when needed.
- Manages voice cloning and text-to-speech workflows with authorization and billing checks.
- All audio generation is handled using the bundled MCP client, with no direct API or host connector calls.
- Includes guidance on error handling, billing, voice confirmation, and automatic safe updates.
summary: Turn written radio-drama ad-break lines into one spoken bumper clip per labeled slot. This radio-drama bumper studio records each pre-roll read, post-roll read, and sponsor bumper from the copy the producer already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 bumper audio files. Use it for radio drama ad-break voiceovers that keep one bumper on each clip.
